company.name: ASSESS Talent Management
company.shortDescription: Machine learning enabled talent management and psychometric testing software.
company.description:
ASSESS Talent Management  is a talent acquisition and mobility company that specializes in psychometric testing and assessment technology and business solutions. Our products and services range from testing development and delivery to assessment center development and operation, in addition to talent management analytics and consulting services.

Our award-winning assessment product has been recognized to be one of the few assessment products that have been tailored and calibrated for the Egyptian and Middle Eastern markets.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $12,500, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $185,611 to $185,611, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
